description: Issues in canonical/issues.json closed by a decision in DECISIONS.md. tools/build-canonical.ts sets status, decision, resolution and evidence on every issue matching `match`, and fails if an entry matches no issue. summary.json counts resolved issues separately from open ones.

resolutions.resolution: DECISIONS.md D2: KENTZOU II (Ndélélé) is treated as a village distinct from Kentzou (chef-lieu of Bombé); no record is moved.

Decree 2010/198 (16 June 2010), p.4: 'DEPARTEMENT DU NYONG-ET-SO'O – Arrondissement d'AKOEMAN, chef-lieu : Akoeman' (ex-District d'Akoeman, carved from Mbalmayo). BUCREP's placement under Nyong-et-Mfoumou is an error in the directory. Verified visually 2026-10-17.
